data.gender_notes: Junnut is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'junna', meaning 'to be gentle' or 'to show mercy'. In Islamic tradition, Junnut symbolizes kindness, compassion, and the gentle nature of Allah. The name Junnut carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind, Merciful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Junnut usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind, merciful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
